biography.value:
Description

The most assertive of sabertusks. Though not all packs possess a leader, those led packs of sabertusks are observed to exhibit more aggression. Some have even reported alphatusks rampaging through houses miles from their own natural habitat.

Defense

AC 20, touch 12; flat-footed 17 (+3 dex, +8 natural, -1 size)

hp 85 (10d8+40), fast healing 7;

Fort +11, Ref +10, Will +5

Resist Fire 10, Holy 5

Weakness Ice

Offense

Speed 50 ft.

Melee 2 Claws +13 (1d8+6 plus grab), Gore +14 (2d8+6 plus trip when charging)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. for Gore)

Special Attacks Powerful Charge, Pounce, Rake (2 claws +13, 1d8+6), Throat-Rip

Statistics

Str 22, Dex 16, Con 18, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 8

Base Atk +8; CMB +15 (+19 grapple); CMD 28 (32 vs. trip)

Feats Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Focus (Gore)

Skills Acrobatics +14, Perception +16, Stealth +14, Swim +19; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Survival when tracking by scent

GM note: Senses Perception +15 conflicts with Skills Perception +16; use the detailed skills entry of +16. Fast healing 7; CMD 32 vs trip.

description.value: An alphatusk can make a full attack when it makes a charge attack.

effect: Full attack at the end of a charge, including rake. Use Powerful Charge for the gore, not an additional gore.

description.value: An alphatusk, when it makes a charge attack, he also deals double damage with his gore attack and gains a free action to do a trip combat maneuver. On a failed combat maneuver check, the alphatusk is not tripped in return. This ability works only on creatures of a size equal to or smaller than the alphatusk.

effect: Charge: one doubled gore, then free trip against a target no larger than the attacker. Charge AC -2 until next turn.

contextNotes.text: On a charge, double the listed gore damage.
On a charge, double the listed gore damage.

description.value: As a full-round action, an alphatusk can deliver a coup de grace against a helpless opponent. If the victim survives the attack, he must succeed on a Fortitude save (DC 10 + damage dealt) or dies. Opponents killed in this manner cannot be raised, but Arise, Full-Life, or the like can restore the slain creature to life.

effect: Only a helpless foe: automatic critical hit. A surviving target rolls Fortitude DC 10 + actual damage or dies. Ordinary Raise cannot restore a victim killed this way; Arise or Full-Life can.
